native_mechanisms: A fixed row versus a second row that may be slipped forward at exactly one house, tried unslipped and at every possible slip position along a shared track
House-by-house lockstep comparison marking match (petal) vs mismatch (knot), paced one count per flute note (uniform, in-step scanning)
Weigh each trial as just its knot-count, keep only the lightest fist and discard all other trials
core_technique: Banded anti-diagonal SIMD Needleman-Wunsch: an O(n) Hamming/one-gap (Kadane) lower-bound score seeds a score-derived band width D=(n-S)/5, refined by a trial narrow pass, then exact banded wavefront DP in int16/int32 AVX2 produces the answer.
